entry.title: Flathead V642 Piston — Single
experienceTags: Pairings: Espresso, dark chocolate, cola, dark rum (projected)
Occasion: Pre-cut short session, after a meal, evening smoke
entry.summaryHtml: Dark chocolate, heavily roasted coffee, mocha, molasses, pecan, black pepper, earth and leather recur across repeated professional tastings of this exact 6½″ × 42 box-pressed Lonsdale. Cigar Aficionado has repeatedly scored the V642 Piston in the high 80s to 90, with praise for its dense dark profile and generally solid construction. The narrow 42 ring is especially well suited to a wrapper-forward Broadleaf presentation, while pre-light splitting into roughly 3″ + 3½″ sessions brings the practical cost to A$23.10 per session. Untasted in this catalogue, so Strength 8 and Quality 8 remain projections.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted projection. Exact-vitola professional reviews have repeatedly landed around 88–90 points. The Index lists the length as 6″, but CAO's official specification and exact-vitola review records identify the V642 Piston as 6½″ × 42.
